item.title: Enabling lab autonomy with reward functions and executable workflows
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01339-0

Kalinin et al. argue that for self-driving laboratories to achieve autonomy in the physical world, large language model hypothesis generation needs to be complemented by bottom-up optimization translating hypotheses into executable workflows.
